subject: metrics
text: - `viola.wait.outcome` counts only the `wait` calls answered by a `channel-response`: a `wait` refused before any frame writes none. The CLI's server-verification refusal (Linux and Windows) is one `process-exit{subject:"self", exit_code:21, detail:"server-verify-failed", during:"connect"}` at WARN in `cli-<name>.ndjson`, counted by the Counter row's `detail` grouping; MCP's `wait` tool writes no line for it.

subject: metrics
text: - A CLI `wait` refused by the instance strict-modes check (`client::refuse_untrusted`: exit 21, the instance pair or the `instance-unreachable` document) writes no line at all, neither a `process-exit` nor a `channel-request`, so neither `viola.wait.outcome` nor the Counter row's `detail` grouping counts it; MCP's `wait` tool refused by its `check_instance` (`instance-unreachable`, `detail: null`) writes none either. The exit code or the `isError` code is its only record.

subject: log-details
text:
- `process-exit` exit 1: `already-live` (a `live` or a `stale` holder of the name, from `viola run` or from `viola revive`, which prints `run`'s own collision pair, or under `--json` the `{"v":1,"error":"already-live","detail":null}` document — revive's preflight refusals under `--json` are the same-shaped document with their code, the logged line unchanged (chunk 2026-10-17-cli-machine-contract); a `gone` holder is taken over with no exit-1 line), `squatted-name`, `pinned-hash-mismatch`, `batch-script-child`, `internal-error`, and from `viola revive`'s start-arm preflight `no-session` (no logged session, or an `--id` the log does not hold), `session-live` (one `claude agents --json` read lists the logged session id live in another `claude`; skipped under `--fork`; a failed, oversize or malformed read passes, fail open; chunk 2026-10-16-unwrapped-sessions-on-the-board) and `cwd-missing` (the snapshot records no directory, or one that is not an existing directory). The preflight reads the holder, then the session, then `session-live`, then the directory, and takes no later reading once one refuses; each refusal is one `process-exit{subject:"self", exit_code:1, detail}` in `run-<name>.ndjson` with no child started. `strict-modes-failed` is no longer one of them (chunk 2026-10-10-budget-governor): the start arm's instance check (`check_instance`) runs before the wrapper log opens and outside the preflight, so its refusal is the stderr `unable:` / `hint:` pair (or under `--json` the `strict-modes-failed` document, chunk 2026-10-17-cli-machine-contract) and exit 1 with no log opened, no `process-start`, no `process-exit` and no child.
 `viola run` and `viola revive`'s start arm also run the home-tree check before the wrapper log opens (`strict::check_home_tree` through `checked_exe` and `refuse_tree`: the home to the read rule, `check_instance`'s set, then `ledger/`, `bin/`, `plugin/`, `bin/<key>/`, the pinned copy, `plugin/<key>/`, its `hooks/` and `.claude-plugin/`, each that exists); its refusal is the home pair (a home-level refusal) or the instance pair (an instance-level one) on stderr and exit 1, with no log opened, no line and no child (revive under `--json` prints the `strict-modes-failed` document), so a refused home tree carries no `process-exit` detail either.
 And `interrupted`: a `viola verify` stopped by Ctrl-C or TERM (Unix `SIGINT` / `SIGTERM`, Windows Ctrl-C / Ctrl-Break) before its rows are checked ends with one `process-exit{subject:"self", exit_code:1, detail:"interrupted"}` in `cli-<name>.ndjson` under a `VIOLA_NAME` (no file with no instance, D-06), after every spawn pair it opened is closed (chunk 2026-10-13-interrupted-verify-cleanup). `schemas/diag-line.v1.json` closes the `process-exit` `detail` at 13 values (the enum's members; 12 before chunk 2026-10-16-unwrapped-sessions-on-the-board, 11 before chunk 2026-10-13-interrupted-verify-cleanup, 9 before chunk 2026-10-10-viola-revive).

subject: log-details
text:
- `process-exit` exit 21: `instance-dead`, `strict-modes-failed`, `server-verify-failed`.
 `server-verify-failed` is written by the eight CLI frame verbs (`send`, `wait`, `last`, `answer`, `pause`, `release`, `link`, `unlink`) on a server that is not the recorded wrapper, or a check that cannot be made (Linux and Windows): `process-exit{subject:"self", exit_code:21, detail:"server-verify-failed", during:"connect"}` at WARN into `cli-<name>.ndjson` (`link` / `unlink`: the driven instance's), with no pid, start time, path or endpoint.

subject: log-details
text:
- `hook-decision` fail-open codes (security Vector 4): `oversize-stdin`, `malformed-json`, `channel-unreachable`, `server-verify-failed`, `strict-modes-failed`, `unverified-cli`, `deadline`. `viola hook statusline` uses three of the seven (the rule: the `detail` codes the arm's fail-open paths write): `oversize-stdin`, `malformed-json`, and `deadline`, which on that arm is the 5 s PROVISIONAL bound on the user's command, not a dialog deadline. Its refused instance check writes no `hook-decision` and no other line (chunk 2026-10-10-budget-governor; before it the arm wrote `strict-modes-failed`, four of the seven). The event and dialog paths run the instance check too (`canonical`, then `trusted`) before `read_diagnostics_level` and obs init, so a refused or absent instance, a `VIOLA_DIR` naming no existing directory included, writes no `hook-decision` and no other line either; no hook arm writes `strict-modes-failed`.
 `server-verify-failed` is written by `viola hook` on a server that is not the recorded wrapper, or a check that cannot be made (Linux and Windows): `hook-decision{detail:"server-verify-failed"}` at WARN into `hook-<name>.ndjson`; on the dialog path the order is `hook-invoked{corr:null}` then `hook-decision{corr:null, decision_emitted:false, detail:"server-verify-failed"}`. `channel-unreachable` is also `connect`'s code when `read_snapshot_or_replay` returns a replayed or absent snapshot (a replay carries no `endpoint`, `pid` or `started_at`): `NotSent::Unreachable`, the hook fails open, and SessionEnd takes its direct append.

subject: log-details
text: - `parse-rejected` (D-05) details, per `parser`: `malformed` (any parser), `unreadable` (`config-json`, `ledger-stamps`, `state-entry`), `oversize` (`channel-frame` beyond `MAX_FRAME`, `hook-stdin`, `mcp-stdin` (a `viola mcp` stdin line past `MAX_FRAME`), `vt100-feed` when the bounded feed queue drops a copy — one line per poisoning episode, `claude-agents-json` for an answer past `MAX_FRAME`, `AgentsFailure::Oversize`), `unknown-keys` (`config-json` skipped keys, counted in `count`), `panicked` (`vt100-feed` under `catch_unwind`), `control-character` (`paste-text`), `symlink-ignored` (`state-entry`), `strict-modes-failed` (`ledger-stamps`: `run`'s version gate refused the stamps file on the strict-modes check, and the read counts as unverified). `diag-line.v1.json` constrains `parse-rejected.detail` to this list (D-31).

subject: log-details
text: - `parse-rejected{parser:"mcp-stdin", detail:"oversize", count:1}` is written at `WARN` into `mcp.ndjson` by `viola_mcp::serve` through `obs_event!`, once per session, after the session ends, only when the stdin reader cut a line past `MAX_FRAME`; it holds no byte of the cut line.

subject: log-details
text:
- Filesystem refusals (Vector 7): `strict-modes-failed` (on `process-exit` exit 21, and on `parse-rejected{parser:"ledger-stamps"}` from `run`'s version gate, at `warn`, with no path; `viola revive`'s start arm and `viola revive --list` both refuse on `viola_state::strict::check_instance` with the stderr pair, or under `--json` the `strict-modes-failed` document, exit 1 and no log line; on `hook-decision` the schema's `detail` enum keeps the word and no arm writes it, since `viola hook statusline`'s refused check leaves no line and neither does the refused instance check of the hook event and dialog paths, made before obs init; chunk 2026-10-10-budget-governor; `viola list`'s refused scan of the home, `instances/` or an instance exits 21 on both forms and writes no line either — no `process-start`, no `process-exit`, no `strict-modes-failed` — so on `process-exit` exit 21 no arm of this build writes the word; chunk 2026-10-11-the-board-viola-list; `viola plugin install`'s refused `check_path` of its home or a `marketplace/` tree dir exits 21 and writes no line either, under `--json` the `instance-unreachable` document (chunk 2026-10-17-optional-plugin-install); `viola link` / `viola unlink`'s refused `check_instance` of the driven instance exits 21 and writes no line either — no `process-start`, no `process-exit` — the fixed instance-state pair on stderr, or under `--json` the `instance-unreachable` document), `pinned-hash-mismatch` (on `process-exit` exit 1), `symlink-ignored`. A skipped symlink has no exit or decision to carry it. The `viola-state` call site that skips a symlinked entry therefore emits `parse-rejected{parser:"state-entry", detail:"symlink-ignored", count}` once per scan, at `warn`, into the scanning process's role file. The entry name and the link target are never logged.
 As landed its call site is `viola_state::board::read` (`viola list`, chunk 2026-10-11-the-board-viola-list): after its loop, one `parse-rejected{parser:"state-entry", detail:"symlink-ignored"|"malformed", count}` per nonzero count of `board::scan` (links ignored; a non-directory or a name that is no `ViolaName`), naming no entry, into `cli-<name>.ndjson` under a `VIOLA_NAME` for `viola list`, and into `mcp.ndjson` for `viola mcp`'s `list` tool (through `list::board_document`, chunk 2026-10-17-mcp-server-for-drivers); `board::scan` itself counts and logs nothing.
 The other refused strict-modes checks write no line either — no `process-start`, no `process-exit`, no `strict-modes-failed`: `send`, `wait`, `last`, `answer`, `pause` and `release` through `client::refuse_untrusted` (exit 21, the instance pair, or under `--json` the `instance-unreachable` document); `viola mcp`'s frame tools (`instance-unreachable`, `detail: null`); `viola verify`'s home-tree check (exit 1, the home pair); and the home-tree check of `viola run` and `viola revive`'s start arm (exit 1, the home or the instance pair).

subject: logs
text:
- **Child / shell spawns:** `process-start` / `process-exit` with `subject` ∈ `version-probe|verify-probe|verify-pty-probe|agents-probe|statusline-shell` (`verify-probe`: `viola verify`'s print-mode probe; `verify-pty-probe`: each of verify's five interactive PTY runs, Run A to Run E; verify logs its eight spawns at the call site, the eighth Run B's `agents-probe` pair, and `run_bounded` and `run_capped` stay unlogged; the `agents-probe` pair is written by `run::agents::read_logged` for `viola list` (into `cli-<name>.ndjson`, only under a parsed `VIOLA_NAME`), for `viola revive`'s `session-live` reading (into `run-<name>.ndjson`) and for verify's Run B; chunk 2026-10-16-unwrapped-sessions-on-the-board; and for `viola mcp`'s `list` tool, whose one read in the `mcp` process writes the pair into `mcp.ndjson`, chunk 2026-10-17-mcp-server-for-drivers). `claude agents --json` parse failure (oversize or malformed) gives one `parse-rejected{parser:"claude-agents-json"}` and the value `"unknown"`.
  - `schemas/diag-line.v1.json` closes `subject` as `$defs.subject.enum` = `self|claude-child|version-probe|verify-probe|verify-pty-probe|agents-probe|statusline-shell`; each of the eight `verify` spawn pairs' `process-exit` carries `child_exit_status` and `duration_ms` (D-35), a child of an interactive PTY run killed at a Ctrl-C or TERM stop included (its `child_exit_status` the PTY pump's exit code, as measured at chunk 2026-10-14-resume-and-compact-ledger-rows; a print-mode or `--version` probe child killed at the stop is not measured); the closed `subject` enum is unchanged (Run E reuses `verify-pty-probe`, Run B's agents read `agents-probe`); a stopped run writes only the pairs it started.
